claims.claim_text: Chime offers FDIC-insured checking accounts and Visa-branded debit cards provided through its bank partners The Bancorp Bank, N.A. and Stride Bank, N.A.; these are the two banks that hold all member deposits and issue Chime products.
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.object_value: The Bancorp Bank, N.A. and Stride Bank, N.A. (FDIC-insured)
claims.source_quote: Chime offers access to full-featured, FDIC-insured checking accounts provided through our platform by one of our bank partners, The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A.

claims.claim_text: The Bancorp (Chime's primary bank partner) holds a slight majority of active accounts and, per the Bancorp MSA, committed to retain certain receivables up to 200% of its tier 1 capital (~$1.8 billion based on Bancorp tier 1 capital as of March 31, 2025).
claims.subject: The Bancorp
claims.predicate: discloses balance-sheet commitment to Chime relationship
claims.object_value: ~$1.8B receivable-retention commitment; majority of active accounts at Bancorp
claims.source_quote: Bancorp committed to retain certain receivables on its balance sheet in an amount, not to exceed, on an aggregate basis, 200% of its tier 1 capital ... Based on Bancorp's tier 1 capital as of March 31, 2025, the amount of this commitment would have been approximately $1.8 billion

claims.claim_text: Chime-branded debit cards are Visa-branded debit cards issued by Chime's bank partners and accepted wherever Visa debit cards are accepted; Chime's payments-based revenue model is driven by interchange fees paid via the card networks (Visa).
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.source_quote: Chime Debit Cards, which are Visa-branded debit cards issued by our bank partners. Chime Debit Cards are accepted wherever Visa debit cards are accepted.

claims.claim_text: Chime has invested in a patent program and as of March 31, 2025 had 24 issued U.S. patents and 77 U.S. patent applications pending.
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.source_quote: As of March 31, 2025, we had 24 issued U.S. patents and 77 U.S. patent applications pending.

claims.claim_text: Chime acquired Salt Labs in 2024 for cash consideration (cash consideration paid for the acquisition of Salt Labs of $13.3 million within investing activities for the year ended December 31, 2024).
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.source_quote: the cash consideration paid for the acquisition of Salt Labs of $13.3 million

claims.claim_text: Chime has built trusted relationships with 8.6 million Active Members, 67% of whom rely on Chime as their primary financial relationship as of March 31, 2025; members used Chime for 54 transactions per month on average.
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.source_quote: we have built trusted relationships with 8.6 million Active Members, with 67% of them relying on Chime to serve as their primary financial relationship as of March 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Members have received $43.3 billion of fee-free overdraft protection through SpotMe since its 2019 launch and $8.8 billion in MyPay advances since its July 2024 launch ($3.5B in Q1 2025).
claims.subject: Chime Financial
claims.source_quote: members have received $43.3 billion of fee-free overdraft protection through SpotMe since its full product launch in 2019 ... members have received $8.8 billion in MyPay advances since its full product launch in July 2024
